name: Skills Lab lists the seeded skills, previews one, and shows the agent's linked count
description: Loads /skills and confirms the seeded skills render as a card grid, selects the rubric card (which opens the side preview rather than navigating — the grid keeps its scroll and toggles stay live), follows 'Open in the editor' into the full editor, and confirms the immutable body renders in the Preview tab. Then opens the Security Reviewer's Skills tab in the agent editor and confirms the linked count. Read-only seeded data throughout: nothing here attaches, reorders or runs anything, so no model call is triggered.

steps.label: the side preview pane opened (selection, not navigation)
skill detail route reached (lands on Config)
the editor tab strip has rendered
preview tab is active in the URL
the skill body renders (its H1) in Preview
skills tab is active in the URL
the seeded links are counted against the whole skill library
